compliance.summary: The case study presents GoGloby as a broad engineering-team builder delivering generic engineering and compliance services, rather than as a specialist Data & AI staffing and recruiting agency. It also makes numerous unsupported claims about this engagement, its metrics, security arrangements, and client profile.

llm_problems.title: General engineering-team positioning
llm_problems.rule: decisions.md: Company description; Fact Sheet: Identity and Services
llm_problems.issue: The page’s central story presents GoGloby as building broad engineering teams and delivering engineering work, rather than specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Rework the case study’s positioning around GoGloby’s approved staffing and recruiting services, and remove claims that present it as a general engineering delivery provider.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.page_value: Builds fully compliant, AI-capable engineering teams
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: GoGloby placed 25 senior engineers across DevOps, Python/Data, Fullstack, and iOS
the entire GoGloby-placed team transitioned to applied AI engineering
By integrating deep HIPAA compliance and an AI-native engineering workforce
GoGloby builds fully compliant, AI-capable engineering teams in parallel.

llm_problems.title: Unverified placement timeline
llm_problems.issue: The sources do not substantiate placing 25 engineers in 58 days for this engagement.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the engagement-specific placement count and timeline before retaining these claims.
llm_problems.subject: Engagement placements

locations.quote: GoGloby placed 25 Senior Applied AI Engineers in 58 days.
GoGloby placed 25 senior engineers across DevOps, Python/Data, Fullstack, and iOS in 58 days.

llm_problems.title: Retention figures conflict
llm_problems.issue: The page calls retention approximately 96%, but also says 23 of 25 engineers remained active, which is 92%; the Fact Sheet’s 96% is a company-wide metric, not support for this case-specific claim.
llm_problems.fix: Verify and reconcile the case-specific retention figure before using it.
llm_problems.subject: Engagement retention
llm_problems.source_value: 96% of engineers still active at 12 months (company-wide)

llm_problems.fix: Verify this engagement-specific rate before retaining it.

llm_problems.title: Unverified assessment pass rate
llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Key metrics; How we vet
llm_problems.issue: The page gives a 3.2% internal vetting rate, while the documented Talent Assessment pass rate is approximately 4%, and does not establish a different case-specific methodology.

llm_problems.fix: Verify the engagement-specific funnel figures before retaining them.

llm_problems.title: Unverified annual savings

llm_problems.fix: Verify the savings calculation and its basis before retaining the claim.

llm_problems.title: Unapproved staffing rates
llm_problems.issue: The page publishes GoGloby’s claimed average annual staffing cost, which the Glossary says not to publish.
llm_problems.fix: Remove GoGloby-specific rates from the public page.

llm_problems.source_value: GoGloby rates must not appear in public content

llm_problems.title: Staffing outside Latin America
llm_problems.issue: The page describes the staffing team as coming from Latin America and Europe, while the documented nearshore staffing service embeds engineers from Latin America.
llm_problems.fix: Verify the engineers’ locations and remove or correct any claim that conflicts with the documented service model.

llm_problems.title: Unverified HIPAA clearance claims
llm_problems.issue: The sources do not establish that 25 engineers received HIPAA certification, PHI training, or HIPAA clearance for this engagement.
llm_problems.fix: Verify each engagement-specific HIPAA training and clearance claim before retaining it.

llm_problems.title: Unverified compliance arrangements

llm_problems.fix: Verify these contractual and regulatory claims before retaining them.

llm_problems.rule: Fact Sheet: Services; Legal and security

llm_problems.fix: Correct the coverage amount to the documented policy or verify and substantiate a different policy for this engagement.

llm_problems.issue: The sources do not document the claimed $3M professional liability or $5M general liability policies.
llm_problems.fix: Verify these additional coverage claims before retaining them.

llm_problems.title: Unverified client profile figures
llm_problems.issue: The client profile gives company and platform figures not present in the Fact Sheet; the documented DrChrono figures are 17M+ patients and $3B in medical claims.
llm_problems.fix: Verify each additional client figure before retaining it, and keep only figures supported by an authoritative source.

llm_problems.fix: Use the CTA wording appropriate to the service being promoted.
